claim: You can run up to 10 CloudShell shells at the same time in each AWS Region for your account; you can request a quota increase for each Region in the Service Quotas console.

evidence.quote: You can run up to 10 shells at the same time in each AWS Region for your account.
You can request an quota increase for each Region by opening the [Service Quotas console](https://eu-west-1.console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home/services/cloudshell/quotas?region=eu-west-1).
